Hi Amira —

Thanks again for taking the time last week. We’re starting the formal renewal & expansion origination for QuantaHealth (term ends 2026-11-30) and I wanted to propose a lightweight kickoff to align stakeholders, confirm the capacity uplift, and schedule the QBR. Key asks in this email:

- Confirm target term change (12 vs 24 months) and whether you want the uplift staged or immediate.
- Review the attached mutual action plan + capacity forecast (see attachments).
- Propose 2x 60-minute QBR windows next week so we can lock in calendar availability for execs.

Suggested kickoff timeline (high level):
1) Kickoff & QBR scheduling (this week) — align stakeholders and agree on target term
2) Draft amendment & legal review (1–2 weeks) — Ben (sales ops/legal) will surface changes
3) Procurement & PO path (1–3 weeks) — Quanta procurement to confirm billing cadence
4) Technical onboarding for uplift (SRE/CS) — Monica to confirm runbook and staffing

Proposed QBR windows (pick two):
- Tue, Sep 28, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Tue, Sep 28, 15:00–16:00 PT
- Wed, Sep 29, 09:00–10:00 PT

Attachments: Quanta_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.pdf, CapacityForecast_Q3-Q4.xlsx

I’ve looped Jordan (procurement) to keep PO coordination visible. Monica (CS) and Ben (legal) are on copy to help with SLOs and contract language. If the team prefers, we can do a short 30-minute technical-only pre-call to validate the KV/prefix caching approach for the uplift.

Next steps: please confirm which QBR slot works and whether you prefer a 12- or 24-month term.

Best,

- If they want immediate full uplift in Dec instead of staging, pricing should include a one-time uplift fee to cover capacity reservation.

I’ll iterate quickly if David confirms the exact per-token delta. Monica — if you can attach the 2-page ops-runbook excerpt, I’ll include a pointer to the technical appendix in the amendment so procurement has it for review.
